_source: Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss, PDF page 101 of RIL-Integrated-Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf (a two-up spread; printed pages 198-199).
_unit: INR crore, exactly as printed. No rescaling. Brackets are negative.
_notes: RIL prints GST Recovered as an explicit deduction, so GST has a real printed counterpart here (TCS does not). RFSP/RFSS are RIL's 'Value of Sales' / 'Income from Services' (gross of GST). PATR is OUT OF SCOPE for RIL: it prints BOTH 'Profit After Tax' (95,610, before share of associates) and 'Profit for the year' (95,754, after) -- TCS's PATR maps to the latter concept, so keying either would be a guess. RIL also prints a standalone basis (PDF pages 58-61), not yet keyed. Re-keyed 2026-11-22: an earlier version was read from PDF page 145, which is Reliance Retail Ventures Limited's statement, not RIL's.
_method: Read from the printed statement via `pdftotext -table`, independent of the pipeline's Azure DI OCR. Every subtotal re-derived by hand and ties.
_coverage: FACE LEVEL, deliberately partial. A tag is listed only where its mapping to a printed line is unambiguous. Tags in NEITHER list are out of scope and ignored by score_document -- putting a disclosed-but-unmappable tag in not_reported would score a CORRECT extraction as a false positive.
